chapter_note: This chapter is overwhelmingly oldest-layer substrate. The teaching is highly systematic: a three-fold enumeration of Adam's cosmic preeminence (image, soul-structure, cosmic seal) followed by a seven-fold enumeration of the rulers' purposes in creating Adam. Every mapping stays within the cosmic system — no paragraph reaches into contemporary institutions, social structures, or religious practices. The only non-substrate material is the dialogue frame opening (¶1) and a brief editorial bridge phrase in ¶6. The body-cosmos correspondence (zodiac sealed in Adam), the elemental distribution teaching, and the seal-ring metaphor are all classic substrate features. Negative editorial fatigue score confirms no drift toward later layers. This is one of the purest teaching chapters in the corpus.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Pure formulaic attribution: 'Once again he speaks to his disciples, who listen to his words.' No cosmological content. High dialogue_frame score (41.67). Standard compilation-layer framing.

paragraphs.core_text: Three great things that are distinct were revealed in Adam the first human. Indeed, due to this, he was found to be better and more outstanding than the conjoined powers that are in heaven and on earth.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Introduces the three-fold enumeration structure. 'Conjoined powers that are in heaven and on earth' is cosmic vocabulary — mixed/bound beings in the cosmic architecture. Both sides of the description stay within the system. The 'Indeed, due to this' formula recurs through ¶3-5 as a structural causal connector within the teaching.

paragraphs.core_text: The first: The image of the exalted one was placed upon him. The creators and moulders of his body sealed him after the shining form of the image that had been displayed to them above. Indeed, due to this, the image of Adam was found to be surpassingly beautiful beyond any conjoined power above and below.
paragraphs.temporal_note: First enumeration item. Maps the Ambassador's cosmic image → Adam's form. 'Creators and moulders' are the archontic powers — cosmic agents. 'Shining form of the image displayed above' refers to the Ambassador's manifestation in the cosmic narrative. Entirely within the system.

paragraphs.core_text: The second thing: Adam was shaped in his structure through the light of the first-born of heaven and [earth ... ] the five sons. Indeed, due to this, his structure was found to differ from the structure of even the other creations; [sin]ce the form of all creations is different. As for Adam, the formation of his soul fits over the correct distribution of the elements. Therefore, he has intelligence surpassing that of the other creations and beasts.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second enumeration item. Critical substrate feature: 'the formation of his soul fits over the correct distribution of the elements' — this is the body-cosmos correspondence mapping soul-structure to elemental distribution. 'The five sons' references the five-element system. Contains lacunae [earth ... ] and [sin]ce. Despite substrate score of 0.0, the content is unmistakably oldest-layer cosmological teaching.

paragraphs.core_text: The third are the teachings and counsels and the seal of all the powers above and below. The creators, who set him in order, gathered them and sealed them in him. Adam and his consort Eve became a dwelling and home for the signs of the zodiac and the stars; and the months, the days and the years. For the seal of the entire universe is stamped upon Adam. Indeed, due to this, heaven and earth moved because of him; trouble and disorder arose on his account between they that are good and they that are evil. So, the good induce him to life because of their image and shape placed upon him; while the [wi]cked were drawing him to death, so that they would have power through him and they would conceive the kingdom, and through him humiliate the entire universe.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third enumeration item. Contains the zodiac-body correspondence: 'Adam and his consort Eve became a dwelling and home for the signs of the zodiac and the stars; and the months, the days and the years.' This is the body-cosmos mapping identified in Ch.69-70 context. 'The seal of the entire universe is stamped upon Adam' — Adam as microcosm. The cosmic struggle between good and evil forces is entirely within the system. Contains lacuna [wi]cked.

paragraphs.core_text: The rulers determined and formed Adam so that they would be masters through him and conceive the kingdom because of seven things.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed 'Furthermore, understand that' — editorial bridge connective ('Furthermore') plus pedagogical imperative ('understand that') transitioning from the three-fold to the seven-fold enumeration. The cosmological content introducing the seven purposes is retained.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Bridge connective flagged by seam detection. However, the content that follows (¶7-13) is entirely cosmological — no institutional vocabulary or contemporary application. The seam flag fires on the connective but the extension stays within the cosmic system. Only the transitional phrase is editorial; the seven-fold enumeration it introduces is substrate.

paragraphs.core_text:
⟨p.158⟩
The first: He became the enlightener in their creation; instead of the light of the image of the Ambassador who had displayed himself to them above. For they all desired the likeness of the image of the Ambassador. Their heart was drawn after it.
paragraphs.temporal_note: First of the seven purposes. Maps Adam's role to the Ambassador's cosmic image — the rulers substitute Adam for the divine light-image. 'Enlightener in their creation' means Adam functioned as their light-source, replacing the Ambassador. Both sides cosmic. Manuscript marker ⟨p.158⟩ preserved.

paragraphs.core_text: The second: So that they would scoop up the light through him and restrain and obstruct it from its ascent to the heights.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second purpose. Describes cosmic light-capture mechanism: Adam as vessel through which the rulers restrain light from ascending. 'Scoop up the light' and 'ascent to the heights' are systematic cosmic process vocabulary. Entirely within the system.

paragraphs.core_text: The third: So that because of the image of the Ambassador that is placed upon him the entirety of the divine that is above and below would be humiliated; on account of the likeness of the splendour, of the beauty of his superiority. For he is superior in his appearance to all creatures.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third purpose. The divine is humiliated through Adam bearing the Ambassador's image — cosmic image-theology within the system. 'The entirety of the divine that is above and below' is cosmic geography.

paragraphs.core_text: The fourth: He is a seal-ring and a new impression, so that all births who will be begotten might be brought forth after his seal.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fourth purpose. Seal-ring/impression metaphor — Adam as template for all subsequent generation. This is the cosmic process by which the form is transmitted through births. Systematic, impersonal.

paragraphs.core_text: The fifth: That might be displayed through him all the skil[ls] of the powers, they above and below, secret and manifest; and that they might determine through him the totality, and every thing be revealed in him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fifth purpose. Adam as the microcosm in which all cosmic powers — above and below, secret and manifest — are displayed. 'Determine through him the totality' — Adam as the instrument of cosmic control. Contains lacuna skil[ls].

paragraphs.core_text: The sixth: That there would come to be a great protection for them through the image of the exalted one that was placed upon him; for as the heavenly would [ ... ] even rulers; and no evil thing would be done to them on account of Adam.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Sixth purpose. The divine image on Adam protects the dark rulers from heavenly retribution — cosmic shield-function. Contains lacuna [ ... ] disrupting the causal clause. Both sides cosmic.

paragraphs.core_text: The seventh: That he might become chief and king and master over all creatures; and they might conceive the kingdom through him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Seventh and final purpose. Adam as ruler over all creatures — the dark powers' instrument for seizing cosmic sovereignty. 'Conceive the kingdom' is the rulers' cosmic ambition expressed through Adam. Closes the seven-fold enumeration. Both sides internal to the cosmic system.
